title: node-embedding-leaf-separation
intention: Build the node/embedding/leaf schema separation: the paper's three-layer schema (§3.1, §6.4) replacing the flat one-table-per-tenant shape. One shared node set (cairn_nodes) owned by the librarian, an embeddings table (cairn_embeddings) for many-per-node vector renderings, per-tree leaf tables referencing the shared set. Migrate 1,314 existing rows across 10 tables. Wire the inference-to-node pipeline so resolved calls deposit as knowledge nodes.
why: The papers cannot be released until the schema they describe is built. The running schema (tree+vector on the node row, separate table per tenant) is an inference cache, not a knowledge base — the librarian cannot answer questions from it across trees. Akien: 'it looks from here like you built an inference cache, rather than have the inference cache be part of the librarian's KB.'
traces_to: Telos 1 — inference compilation: leaf separation improves embedding quality for the tree
Law 3 — nothing is known until measured: separation is measured by retrieval precision

falsifier.proves_red: A deposit creates rows in fewer than 3 tables; nearest() fails to join across three tables; any existing proof suite exits nonzero; no code path connects inference_calls to the shared node set; charters still describe the flat schema.

New file cairn/devices/librarian/ingest.py holds the logic as plain functions: call_id(row) -> str, answer_text(row) -> str | None, and ingest(ask, embed, *, table='librarian_inference_calls', conn=None) -> dict. ask(body) -> {'calls': [...]} and embed(text) -> list[float] are passed in, so the module imports neither the bus nor inference_domain; it imports only trees (deposit, NODES_TABLE, DepositRefused) and db_domain's store. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED'

inference_calls has no id column (measured 2026-10-13: read_ticket rows carry canonical, verdict, answer, falsifier, horizon, provenance, cost, created). call_id(row) = sha256(canonical + '|' + created)[:16] hex, computed by the librarian from the row the 'calls' verb returns; b905340f8162 is not touched. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED'

A row is resolved when verdict == 'miss' and answer.body.response is a non-empty string (a generate call the host answered). A 'hit' re-serves an answer already ingested at its miss, a 'refused' row has answer NULL, and an embed row carries a vector but no answer text: all three deposit nothing and are counted in the result under skipped. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED'

A generate row carries no embedding, so the vector is one embed(text) through the inference door: the device handler passes embed_via_bus(reach('inference_domain')) from cairn/devices/librarian/live.py:103 (imported inside the handler, since live.py imports device.py). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED'

Each resolved row: trees.deposit(content=answer_text(row), vector=embed(text), provenance={'source': 'inference_calls', 'call_id': call_id(row), 'call_created': row['created']}, tree='inference_calls', table=<the table arg>, conn=conn). A DepositRefused (content under the 8-char floor) is caught and counted under skipped['refused'], never raised. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED'

Before depositing, ingest reads cairn_nodes for provenance->>'call_id' = cid OR provenance->'attestations' @> [{'call_id': cid}] (the second form catches a call whose answer text matched an older node and landed as an attestation). A hit skips the row (skipped['already']). So a second ingest over the same calls writes no node, no embedding, no leaf and no attestation. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED'

ingest asks ask({'limit': 1000, 'since': S}) where S = the max provenance->>'call_created' over cairn_nodes rows whose provenance source is 'inference_calls' (or attestations carrying one); none yet means since is omitted. S is derived from the nodes themselves: no high-water file, no instance-space state. Rows at exactly S are dropped by the verb and were ingested already. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED'

LibrarianDevice gains declared_verbs() = {**super().declared_verbs(), 'ingest': self._handle_ingest}. _handle_ingest(envelope) builds ask = lambda body: bus.request(sender='librarian', to='inference_domain', verb='calls', why='librarian ingest', body=body)['body'] and embed = embed_via_bus(bus), with bus = reach('inference_domain'), and returns ingest(ask, embed)'s dict {'asked', 'deposited', 'skipped': {'unresolved', 'already', 'refused'}}. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED'

The trigger is the 'ingest' bus verb: whoever wants the calls in the tree asks, and the ask is the event. No poller, no beat, no timer, and inference_domain sends nothing (D2). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED'

(2) test_a_second_ingest_adds_nothing: a second ingest over the same rows returns deposited 0 and the node's provenance, the embeddings count and the leaf count are unchanged.
